Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.label: fire
Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.description: Fire. It burns, heats and spreads: sets things alight, holds a fire that never spreads, takes the heat out of flames and keeps it, raises walls of flame, sears wounds shut, wards a friend against burning. Price - raging flame: if the caster loses the hold, fire keeps breaking out at their feet for a while.

Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.label: water
Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.description: Water. It pushes, soaks, slows and puts fires out: a burst that throws foes back, standing water that holds them, water drawn out of a body, a geyser, a curtain, a jet. Price - chilled to the bone: if the hold slips, the water soaks the caster instead.

Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.label: earth
Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.description: Earth. Stone, soil and weight: a tremor that knocks foes off their feet, stone that grips them, spikes from below, walls raised between two points, a crack running through the ground. An earth caster can go under the ground and come up anywhere they like, and the ground breaks open where they do. Price - stone-bound: if the hold slips, the caster stiffens like stone for a while.

Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.label: air
Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.description: Air. Wind and breath: a gust that throws foes back, air too thin to breathe, an updraft, a wall of wind, a blow that leaps from one foe to the next - and lightning, when water joins it in a storm. The wind feeds fire as easily as it snuffs it out. An air caster can be carried over walls and water. Price - winded: if the hold slips, the wind tears the breath out of the caster.

Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.label: light
Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.description: Light: radiance and sight. A great element - its circle holds others. It burns the wrong, reveals and blinds. Its spells are not made yet. Price: not decided yet.

Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.label: time
Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.description: Time: ageing, slowing, foresight. A great element - its circle holds others. Its spells are not made yet. Price: not decided yet.

Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.label: life
Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.description: Life: moving the strength of one living thing into another - grass drained to mend a wound. Blood is its branch. A great element - its circle holds others: round other circles, it heals the friends the spell touches. Price: not decided yet.

Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.label: darkness
Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.description: Darkness: interpretation - the touch on every living mind. Woven with another element, it distorts it; what comes of it depends on what it is woven with. A great element - its circle holds others. Its spells are not made yet. Price: not decided yet.

Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.label: space
Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.description: Space: the room between the caster and the thing - its mass, its distance, the threads that catch it (telekinesis). A great element - its circle holds others. Its spells are not made yet. Price: not decided yet.

Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.label: aura
Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.description: A form: a field round the caster, lasting while it is held. Its element decides what it does to those inside.

Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.label: enchanting
Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.description: A form: the element laid onto a weapon, a body or an ally for a while.

Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.label: step
Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.description: A form: moving - the caster, or another - through or by the element.

Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.label: restoring
Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.description: A form: returning a thing or a body towards how it was - mending, cleansing, undoing.

Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.label: beam
Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.description: A form: a lasting channel from the caster to a line or a target, while the caster holds it. Hard, and strong.

Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.label: shaping
Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.description: A form: changing the ground or things - melting, raising, freezing, ageing. Hard, and far-reaching.

Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.label: summoning
Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.description: A form: calling forth a creature or a thing of the element. Hard. (Spirits are not made yet.)

Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.label: sensing
Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.description: A form: seeing, finding, foreseeing - through the element. Hard, and quiet.
